Print contract

A3 trim: 297 × 420 mm. A2 trim: 420 × 594 mm.

Bleed: 3 mm all sides. Safe: 10 mm inside trim. QR stays above 32 mm at A3 and 45 mm at A2.

Visual grammar

Live Nahlas palette and font roles. One diagonal evidence field; one yellow case ticket; one four-step accountability chain.

No rounded cards. No generic activist iconography. Photos show infrastructure and evidence, never a person as the “problem.”

Copy + privacy

Anger points at neglect. Reports stay private until review. Nothing is published automatically. Browser removes photo metadata; public pins are rounded.

If a matching report is approved, Nahlas can pool it into one public case with a named authority, deadline and permanent update history.

Placement guidance: use only owner-approved windows, community noticeboards, licensed poster frames, partner venues, event spaces, and other surfaces where posting is expressly permitted. Do not obscure safety signs, transport information, heritage surfaces, private doors, or existing lawful notices.
